title: 22. Interview: SOLID principles & design patterns — visual guide
summary: Interview Q&A for SOLID principles & design patterns — visual guide.
objectives: Answer the SOLID principles & design patterns — visual guide interview questions out loud
Lead with the concept, then a small example, then a tradeoff

sections.title: Interview Tips
sections.body:
### Common Questions:

1. **"Explain Singleton pattern and its drawbacks"**
   - Global state, testing issues, thread-safety

2. **"Difference between Factory and Abstract Factory?"**
   - Factory: One product, Abstract Factory: Family of products

3. **"When to use Decorator vs Inheritance?"**
   - Decorator: Runtime, flexible, multiple features
   - Inheritance: Compile-time, rigid

4. **"Observer pattern real-world example?"**
   - Newsletter subscriptions, event systems, MVC

5. **"Strategy vs State pattern?"**
   - Strategy: Choose algorithm
   - State: Behavior changes with state

### How to Answer:
1. Define the pattern
2. Draw a diagram
3. Give real-world example
4. Mention pros/cons
5. Show code if needed
